rounds.main_learning: A small one-call contract beat clustering and a two-stage locator/normalizer.
Information order helped, but same-year company formation and verbatim evidence remained unstable.
Field-level grounding produced the only unanimous clean training round.
Paragraph structuring did not improve recall; two-stage processing was slower and lost candidate coverage.
Title salience and atomic status splitting solved different cases, but neither met all hard gates.

failure_reasons: completed executive move was marked started
a strong current event was missed
holdout.action: The failed article was moved to Round 4 training and replaced with an unseen article.
holdout.reason: No Round 5 variant cleared the training convergence gate.

acceptance_gate.required: three consecutive unseen holdout hard passes

next_recommended_experiment: Combine the Round 5 title guard and atomic mixed-status rules as a new post-cap variant.
Move quote exactness from prompt compliance to deterministic source-span restoration.
Calibrate a written gold policy for same-year facts used only as career or company-history context.
Use a fresh disjoint training batch before reopening holdout acceptance.
